values: Enter planned quantities in column D. The totals above the table update from the material cost per piece. Quantity starts at zero.
Workshop 0 means hand building. Listed research points are the recipe cost; shared door/window unlocks need no separate purchase after their wall is known.
T3+ research permanently selects a specialization in its tab. Research budget: 48 points per character; this catalogue is not an all-unlocks progression plan.
All pieces also require exploration/material access at their tier. The main structural pieces IDs 0–7 and T1 decorations/openings are free blueprints.
Gates have their own prior-tier gate prerequisite. Door/window walls share the matching tier structural wall prerequisite.

values: Workshop upgrades are separate recipes, not additional placeable entries in the 105-piece catalogue.
A ground-eligible piece anchors only if all four sampled footprint corners sit no more than 0.15m above or 0.65m below the terrain.
Strength starts at 100 and loses 8 + 12 × horizontal distance + 12 × positive centre-height rise along each connected support link.
Every piece needs support strength of at least 1. Connected pieces must touch within the building tolerances.
Each piece carries its own weight plus loads routed to it through its child support links. Exceeding capacity makes the layout invalid.
Manual removal is rejected if it would leave an unsupported or overloaded structure.
Enemy destruction can cause unsupported or overloaded pieces to collapse.
New tiered door walls and perimeter gates are manual at all tiers. Their swing needs clear space. Legacy T4+ doors need power.
Real firing aperture with a sill and solid frame; advanced tiers include a mullion. Frames remain structural.
Water runs on a 120s cycle, drying on 240s and farming on 360s. Yield per cycle equals tier; stock cap is 20 × tier. Active play only.
Fueled generators supply equipment within 24m. T4+ production, electric defenses and T5 turrets need power. Modules can improve production.
15 resource slots, each capped at 200 × storage tier. Shared world inventory. Powered refrigerators stop food spoilage.
Repair any damaged placed piece for 2 timber. Vehicle repair station uses 3 alloy to repair nearby vehicles/mobile structures.
Each resident needs a cot; shelter checks for a roof and two nearby walls. Furniture can personalize interiors.
The catalogue includes existing vehicle/trailer entries. Their further development is deferred; fixed settlement-site claiming is not implemented.
